blurb: Mosaic is where creativity and community come together in Downtown Sioux Falls. It’s a living, breathing canvas, where echoes of past joy blend with the anticipation of future celebrations. Every event is a work of art, every class an inspiration, and every visitor an artist adding their own brushstroke to a collective masterpiece.
